summary: Install-time execution of tarball fetched from unpinned third-party host
details: multi-acct@2.0.999 declares its sole dependency `vector-cursor-stream-engine` as a direct tarball URL at https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/vector-cursor-stream-engine rather than a registry-published package. The npm-shrinkwrap.json entry for this dependency has `hasInstallScript: true`. On `npm install`, npm fetches this tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com and runs its lifecycle script on the installer's machine. The tarball URL is unversioned, unpinned to any integrity hash, and served from a host that is neither the npm registry nor a publisher domain associated with this package, so the fetched bytes and the code they execute can change at any time without any change to multi-acct itself.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
